_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), set 31/3/3 (footer code 2231/3/3), sibling of 31/3/1. plan.txt gives no skip list (the scheme has no numbered cells), so every question was matched to 31/3/1 by CONTENT and the whole paper is kept here. 32 page images, folio = idx + 1. idx 0 bilingual cover, idx 1 Hindi General Instructions, idx 2 English General Instructions (no questions), then Hindi/English pairs: English on EVERY EVEN index 4-30 (idx 4 Q1-4, 6 Q5-7, 8 Q8-10, 10 Q11-14, 12 Q15-16 + the A-R block, 14 Q17-21, 16 Q22-25, 18 Q26-28, 20 Q29-32, 22 Q33-35(a), 24 Q35(b)-36(b), 26 Q37, 28 Q38-39(a), 30 Q39(b)-(c)), Hindi on every odd index 3-29 (each the Hindi of the page after it), checked on the contact sheet: all Devanagari from the top, no English overflow; the parity holds throughout. idx 31 (folio 32) is BLANK. Instructions (i)-(vii) confirm sci80 (39 q, A 1-20 MCQ, B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4). Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms pages 3-12, footer 'X SCIENCE 31/3/3') for a bare OR: after Q22, 24, 27, 34, 35, 36, 37 (c), 38 (c), 39 (c) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page as an image; each was re-derived and agrees; no void note anywhere in the scheme. Differences from 31/3/1 on shared material, read on both papers' pages: Q10 option (C) prints 'Abscissic Acids' where 31/3/1 Q8 prints 'Abscissic Acid', so it is transcribed fresh; Q28 replaces 31/3/1 Q27(b) 'Sodium metal is stored in bottle filled with kerosene oil' with 'Calcium starts floating when immersed in water', so it is transcribed fresh; the Assertion-Reason instruction prints 'Q. 17 to 20' here where 31/3/1 prints 'Q. Nos. 17 to 20', so the context follows this page (an MCQ hash does not read context). Q24 (b) prints a double space in 'magnetisation of  a cylinder', a typesetting slip, so the 31/3/1 text was kept. Decimal points on this PAPER are ordinary full stops (Q32: 1.5 V; Q34(b)(ii): 1.5 cm); the scheme prints raised dots, which are not transcribed.
